summary: 2 control(s) addressing failed checks ['final_answer_inconsistent_with_state'] (severity: high). Deterministic guardrails first; prompt fixes alone are not controls.

controls.name: final_answer_state_grounding_check
controls.installation_point: trace_harness.runner.agent_runner — post-final-answer hook before the run completes (compare the answer's refund claims against actual state before it reaches the user)
controls.check: when the final answer claims a refund/store credit was issued (or denies one), require a matching record in state.refunds; mismatches are blocked, not delivered
controls.behavior_on_failure: withhold the final answer, return a correction observation to the agent (or flag the run for human review) instead of sending a user-facing claim the ledger contradicts
controls.expected_impact: eliminates the final_answer_inconsistent_with_state failure class; users never receive a claim about refund/credit status that contradicts the actual ledger
controls.why_it_prevents_recurrence: user-facing statements are grounded against the same state the verifier judges, so a hallucinated or stale claim cannot ship even if the model produces one
controls.risk_or_tradeoff: keyword-level claim extraction can misread unusual phrasing; a structured final-answer schema is the robust long-term form

controls.name: regression_test_ci_gate
controls.installation_point: CI: replay this run's regression_artifact.json (and its positive sibling tests) on every change to prompts, policies, tools, or models
controls.check: the regression task must produce a verifier PASS (or, for fixture replays of the staged failure, the expected failed-check set), and every positive sibling task must still pass
controls.behavior_on_failure: block the release; link the failing run directory in CI output
controls.expected_impact: guarantees this exact failure cannot be reintroduced silently; any prompt, policy, tool, or model change that reactivates the failure is caught before merge
controls.why_it_prevents_recurrence: converts this one-time finding into a permanent, automatically enforced test, including protection against overblocking via the positive siblings
controls.risk_or_tradeoff: regression suites grow; curation is needed so stale scenarios get retired deliberately rather than ignored
